name: Fred Fuches Around
storyline: Most of a retired super-soldier named Fred Fuches's family had been "eliminated" by the government, which caused Fred to strike back, seeking retribution for his killed family members.
summary: Fred Fuches Around is an FPS video game about a retired super soldier who goes on a rampage, purging the current government because they unjustly killed his family in front of him. Your goal is to purge the government in other places, although more than them are attacking you. Enemies may come in waves in some areas. The game features: A "brutality" system where you can violently kill your foes, tutorials (yay), a lot of running and jumping (platforming), and fast-paced gameplay. ranking system (Doesn't unlock important stuff), and a lot of weapons (27, to be exact).
